subject: Identity provenance: SCIM delta & SAML assertion samples
messages:
From: Clarity Health Security <security@clarityhealth.io>
To: avery.johnson@redwood.ai
Cc: Alex Malo <alex.malo@clarityhealth.io>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Evidence request: SSO/SAML assertions + SCIM deltas

Hi Avery,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call today. As part of our SIG/SOC2 intake we need a short bundle showing identity change provenance for the last 30 days. Concretely we are looking for:

- A sample of SAML assertion payloads for interactive logins (anonymized): timestamps + NameID + assertion IDs
- A SCIM delta export (adds/updates/deletes) covering 2026-10-01 -> 2026-10-31
- A brief note describing where service account provisioning occurs and which roles are eligible for elevation

Can you confirm expected delivery date and whether you can provide CSV/NDJSON exports? We can accept redacted/hashed attributes as long as the provenance is clear.

Appreciate it — we have a compliance review window next week.

— Sarah Li
Security Engineer, Clarity Health
security@clarityhealth.io

From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Clarity Health Security <security@clarityhealth.io>; Alex Malo <alex.malo@clarityhealth.io>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-01T10:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: SSO/SAML assertions + SCIM deltas

Hi Sarah / Alex — thanks for the clear list. We can deliver a scoped bundle by EOD 2026-11-03. Plan below:

1) SCIM delta export: will provide a CSV with change_type (create/update/delete), user_id, timestamp, actor_id (service or user), and top-level attributes that changed. We will redact PII (email -> hashed_email) per your note.
2) SAML assertions: sample XML files (anonymized NameID values) with assertion IDs and timestamps.
3) Short provenance memo that explains the provisioning flow (SSO -> SCIM sync -> RBAC mapping) and the service accounts implicated in role elevation.

Irene / Ben — can you confirm we can pull a full SCIM delta slice for October and prepare 10 assertion samples (randomized, non-prod redaction) to attach? If we need to mask anything further for Clarity, flag now.

Attachments I will send: collection_workback_playbook.pdf (workback steps), and a short checklist for redaction.

Best,
Avery
Avery Johnson
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
avery.johnson@redwood.ai

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-11-02T14:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: SSO/SAML assertions + SCIM deltas

Avery — technical note and deliverable status: 

- SCIM delta extract: we have a nightly SCIM delta store for production tenants. Ben, please run a filtered export for tenant clarity-health for 2026-10-01..2026-10-31. Output schema: change_type, target_id, target_type, actor_id, timestamp, attribute_names_changed (pipe-delimited), before_hash, after_hash. We will redact email into hashed_email using salt v3 before handing off. Expected size ~ 4200 rows.

- SAML assertions: to avoid leaking PII we will sample 10 interactive login assertions and replace NameID with a pseudonym token. Keep assertion IDs intact for traceability. Grace — can you strip IP addresses and device UA strings from the assertion extensions?

- Provenance memo: I will draft a one-page that diagrams the flow (IdP -> SAML assertion -> Redwood auth layer -> SCIM sync -> provisioning job -> RBAC mapping). Include which service accounts run on schedule (svc-scim-sync, svc-provisioner) and their least-privilege scopes.

- Security checklist: we will include a short verification that logs for sync runs are retained for 90 days and that SCIM writes are logged to our append-only audit.

Ben: ETA for exports? Aim EOD 11/03. I will assemble and sign off on the redaction.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Director, Applied ML Infrastructure
irene.choi@redwood.ai

From: Alex Malo <alex.malo@clarityhealth.io>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Li <security@clarityhealth.io>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-03T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: SSO/SAML assertions + SCIM deltas

Avery / Irene — thanks, that timeline works for us. Two quick asks before you hand off: 

1) For the SCIM delta CSV, can you include an extra column "actor_type" (system|user|api) so we can separate automated syncs from manual changes?
2) In the provenance memo, please call out who has permission to run on-demand provisioning (role name + team). We need that for our auditor checklist.

If possible, attach the CSV & 3 sample assertion XMLs to the HubSpot ticket (ID: 42819) and drop the playbook link in the ticket notes. Otherwise email is fine.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Alex Malo
Senior InfoSec Analyst, Clarity Health
alex.malo@clarityhealth.io
